briefing: Mythic is a cross-platform, post-exploitation red-team framework built with Go, Docker, and a browser UI. It is controlled with mythic-cli, runs as Docker containers, and hosts no payload types or C2 profiles itself — agents (such as apollo, apfell, poseidon, athena, and medusa) and C2 profiles (such as http, smb, tcp, and websocket) are installed separately into an operator's own instance. This Project ATMA console is a static front end for that platform: demo callbacks, a configuration-only payload builder, and an AI assistant. It does not run a Mythic server or build real payloads.
